## Change

Describe the bounded change and the Interop Case, artifact, workflow, or governance surface affected.

## Authority and scope

- What does this repository own here?
- Which upstream baselines or authorities remain external?
- Does this change alter a maturity, interoperability, conformance, security, or certification claim?

## Evidence

- [ ] Relevant positive path exercised
- [ ] Relevant negative/adversarial path exercised
- [ ] Generated outputs refreshed where applicable
- [ ] Documentation/claim boundaries updated where applicable
- [ ] Reproduction command or CI evidence identified

## Validation

List local commands and/or GitHub Actions runs used to validate the change.

## Revocation / rollback

State how the change can be corrected, superseded, or reverted without destroying historical evidence.
